evidence: Isolated: task.toml:28 `environment_mode = "separate"` under [verifier]; task.toml:37-38 `[verifier.environment]` / `network_mode = "public"` (public network, no allowed_hosts, which the workbook row and SKILL.md delivery profile state is correct). The agent image copies only `instructions/` and `assets/` (environment/Dockerfile:14-15), and tests/Dockerfile:43-44 does `COPY . /tests` then `chmod -R go-rwx /tests`, so grading code lives only in the verifier image. Credentialed: task.toml:30-35 is `[verifier.env]` / `REWARDKIT_JUDGE = "claude-code"` / `REWARDKIT_MODEL = "z-ai/glm-5.3-flashx"` / `ANTHROPIC_BASE_URL = "https://openrouter.ai/api"` / `ANTHROPIC_AUTH_TOKEN = "${OPENROUTER_API_KEY}"` / `ANTHROPIC_API_KEY = ""`. An od dump of those lines shows exactly those five keys in the frozen order, LF endings, no CR in the file, no extra key and no literal secret; it matches the frozen block in staged-task-contract.md, and `diff` of the frozen template task.toml against the task shows only lines 5-7, 10-12 and 14-15 (name, description, keywords, difficulty, category, provenance, arena_slice) changed, so the [verifier], [verifier.env] and [verifier.environment] tables are unchanged from the shared template. Pinned: tests/Dockerfile is byte-identical (cmp) to the frozen template; bases `node:22-bookworm-slim` and `python:3.12-slim`; npm `@anthropic-ai/claude-code@2.1.281`, `@openai/codex@0.151.0`, `@playwright/mcp@0.0.79`, `express@5.1.0`, `better-sqlite3@12.4.1`; pip `harbor-rewardkit==0.1.7`; chromium installed by the playwright CLI bundled with the pinned @playwright/mcp. apt packages are unpinned, which check-dockerfiles.py defines as a NOTE. judge.toml: tomllib parse of all five files gives [judge] keys exactly judge, mode, timeout, isolated, prompt_template, mcp_servers with `judge = "claude-code"` (the expected fallback, equal to REWARDKIT_JUDGE); the part of each judge.toml before the first [[criterion]] is identical to the template; a grep for `^\s*(model|reasoning_effort|temperature)\s*=` over tests/*/*/judge.toml returns nothing and the only `weight =` lines are per-criterion weights. A recursive grep for glm, z-ai, openrouter, REWARDKIT_, ANTHROPIC_, sk-or and api_key across the frozen task hits only task.toml:31-35 and the guard at tests/test.sh:63-64, so no model name or credential is duplicated elsewhere, and test.sh is byte-identical to the template. Counterexample attempts: (a) a judge.toml silently naming another model, (b) an extra or reordered env key or a literal key in [verifier.env], (c) an unversioned npm/pip install or a `latest` base in tests/Dockerfile, (d) test.sh overriding the judge env; none is present. Residual notes that are not defects under this row: the base images are pinned by tag rather than digest, which is the template-controlled convention and what check-dockerfiles.py accepts; `${OPENROUTER_API_KEY}` resolution and a full verifier launch are not measured on these bytes. The index holds scripted golden results run in the agent image, and a hosted configured-judge run on an earlier candidate (Oracle 0.9833 in result.json, hash verified) which shows the same shared wiring can launch and grade but is not a measurement of this candidate. That full-verifier evidence gap belongs to the pipeline's runtime records and the runtime rows, not to this static wiring row.
